title: Battle of Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki", at revision 1379960678, opens: "The Battle of Nowy Dwór was fought during 20 – 30 September 1655 between forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth commanded by Jan Kazimierz Krasiński on one side, and on the other Swedish Empire forces commanded by Gustaf Otto Stenbock. It ended in Swedish victory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2615524, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1655 battle of the Second Northern War ('Swedish Deluge')". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
